claim_ceiling: Repairs only passive Atlas registry completeness and classification semantics. It does not change Current Map authority, owner/helper authority, routes, Bank, Continuous Run, storage, persisted user data, or the already-passing Active Path scanner freeze logic.

diagnostic_matrix_update.rationale: Fresh iPhone Atlas proof passed the freeze gate but exposed 42 reachable registry gaps. The bounded audit proved 20 need explicit current/support/recovery registry semantics while 22 must be known-but-non-authoritative. The browser proof requires exact counts, correct recovery reclassification, and zero mount slots for intentional-outside entries.

observed_facts.fact: The pre-repair Mount Registry had no RECOVERY_REACHABLE or INTENTIONAL_OUTSIDE_ACTIVE_ATLAS buckets and defaulted unlisted reachable references outside its curated four-bucket registry.
The Current Map separately declares recovery routes and current tool routes, so recovery references must not be conflated with current boot authority.

inferred_conclusions.conclusion: Recording the 20 audited registry omissions under current/support/recovery semantics and the 22 known exclusions under a no-slot intentional-outside bucket removes unexplained registry gaps without granting new runtime authority.

cases: recovery controller must not remain ACTIVE_CURRENT_APP
all ten Current Map recovery references must be RECOVERY_REACHABLE
all twenty-two intentional-outside references must be known to the registry
intentional-outside references must receive zero mount slots
protected manifest, integrity service worker, and ownership registry must be current-control-plane registry entries
current tool routes and immediate support dependencies must be support entries
registry presence must explicitly grant no owner/helper/route authority
